notes: This dataset encompasses a collection of water points across Ethiopia, each annotated with administrative region tags (Admin 1, Admin 2, and Admin 3) to facilitate detailed geographic analysis. Sourced as secondary data from mWater, the dataset compiles information from multiple sources collected at various times. It provides insights into water accessibility, infrastructure types, and management across different regions. However, users are advised to exercise caution as the dataset may include water points that are no longer available or may omit new ones due to the nature of data collection. The degree of confidence in the accuracy and completeness of the data is moderate, reflecting the variability in source data and the dynamic nature of water point status. This resource is particularly useful for stakeholders in humanitarian response, development planning, and resource management, offering a broad overview but requiring validation for precision-critical applications.

3iS is an international NGO that provides information management services to humanitarian and development organizations.
Through information management, we help our partners target assistance to the world's most vulnerable populations.
Today, we work with the humanitarian and development sector in 10 different countries, having been active in more than 25 countries in the last 15 years. We have carried out more than 300 projects and currently have a team of 150 people working all over the world.
Our work focuses on using innovation and technological knowledge generated by the private and academic sectors, in order to enhance the power of information to achieve a direct and concrete impact at the level of the beneficiaries, which are the organizations we support. Our experience, your impact!
